description: CommandMate #3002, the side effect the owner confirmed as intended: a test path written ONLY in `## 完了条件` of an issue that has `## 対象ファイル` no longer reaches the scope, so the acceptance criterion that demands it raises `acceptance_requires_tests_but_scope_has_none` — the run stops on a question instead of dispatching a worker with a permission nobody declared. `.rs` derives no L1 test companion, so nothing else puts a test path in scope. The fix the question names is one line: list the test under `## 対象ファイル`.
